title: Dereth Town Tour - Lin scratch

shots.standingOrder: Glide north up the forested gorge of Lin between its cliffs, the Life Stone, the portal and the skeleton statue appearing on the valley floor ahead.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING + GORGE (drone.canyon-run). A 107 m glide north up Lin's forested gorge 20 m above the valley floor (the cliffs rise 26-48 m and the pine-clad rims higher on both sides), looking 28 m ahead and 14 deg down with a gentle bank through one bend: the valley-floor halls, the Life Stone, the town portal and the skeleton statue come up ahead under the high sun.
